title: Why Did France Buck the Global Obesity Trend?

scenes.narration: Did you know one major Western nation actually saw adult obesity fall by 3% since the year 2000?

visual.text: Why Did France Buck the Global Obesity Trend?

scenes.narration: While English-speaking nations saw massive climbs, France completely diverged from global patterns.
In 2010, the adult obesity rate in France reached a high of 12.9%.
Since that peak, the French obesity rate steadily dropped down to 11.2% in 2024.
This proves that local policies and dining culture can reshape public health. The full story is on the channel.

visual.text: Local environment and policies shift outcomes

title: 41 Percent of American Adults Face Obesity Today

scenes.narration: Did you know that 41.0% of adults in the United States are living with obesity today?

visual.text: 41 Percent of American Adults Face Obesity Today

scenes.narration: Back in the year 2000, that number stood at 27.5%.
That represents a massive 49% surge in obesity prevalence across the nation over just two decades.
High daily food energy plays a huge role, with 3,947 calories available per person daily in the US.
That puts America far above peer nations like the UK at 27.4%. The full story is on the channel.

title: The Unseen 128 Percent Jump in Japan's Obesity Rate

scenes.narration: Why did Japan's adult obesity rate jump by a staggering 128% since the year 2000?

visual.text: The Unseen 128 Percent Jump in Japan's Obesity Rate

scenes.narration: At the turn of the century, Japan reported an adult obesity rate of just 2.6%.
Fast forward to 2024, and that figure has climbed steadily upward to 5.9%.
That means the current rate is 2.3 times higher than it was at the start of the century.
It shows how modern economic shift is impacting even traditionally lower-weight countries. The full story is on the channel.

visual.text: Global lifestyle changes impact even low rates
